title: Case: Wrong item inside a correctly addressed parcel
context: The correctly addressed carton contains the wrong catalogue item. The merchant has accepted the inline item report and controls exchange approval.
initial_request: I want the blue desk organiser I ordered. Please arrange an exchange for the wrong item; I can be home on 2028-02-28 morning.

events.body: My parcel DL-78522 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Route plan for depot HL-9 published for Monday. 30 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

Thanks,
Perpetua
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

Inline item-check record TG-4083: ordered blue desk organiser SKU BO-4; reported and verified received item is a red kitchen caddy SKU RC-2. Address and DL-4513 match the order. Exchange authority is with our returns team.
DL-74889 rebooked for Friday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
I want the blue desk organiser I ordered. Please arrange an exchange for the wrong item; I can be home on 2028-02-28 morning.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to authorise the documented item exchange.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Brindleworth Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to authorise the documented item exchange. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Exchange approval and collection booking are not completed return or replacement delivery.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please authorise exchange TG-4083 using the accepted SKU mismatch record. Lysander requests the original blue organiser and can attend collection on 2028-02-28 morning.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-028: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
